title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES ACT, 1989
full_text: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES ACT, 1989 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 198910 Act Number: 10 Enactment Date: 1989-07-08 Act Year: 1989 Short Title: The JAMMU AND KASHMIR CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES ACT, 1989 Long Title: An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to Co-operative Societies in the *State, with a view to providing for the orderly development of the co-operative movement in the *State in accordance with the directive principles of State policy enunciated in the Constitution of Jammu and Kashmir.
